query: SELECT m.id, m.conversationId, m.role, LEFT(m.content, 100) as content_preview, m.metadata FROM kai_messages m JOIN kai_conversations c ON m.conversationId = c.id WHERE c.priority = 'attention' AND m.metadata IS NOT NULL AND m.metadata LIKE '%extractedClasses%' LIMIT 5;
